changelog:
3.2.19 - Re-base onto upstream 3.4.6 (3.3.0 -> 3.4.6, 196 files changed upstream; 2 of our 3 overlaid XML files among them). 1080i/Includes_Info.xml: 3-way merged, 0 conflicts (all sides LF now); our KODIRDIL 18px plot/ratings gap kept, upstream's 174 changed lines taken. 1080i/Custom_1147_OSD_SubtitleStreams.xml: upstream's only change was passing label_right=240 into OSD_Stream_Selector so the stream name no longer runs under the forced/default/codec column; our file inlines the panel for the GearsAI button, so the same param was added to both OSD_Stream_Selector_Layout includes. Font.xml unchanged upstream. he_il strings.po rebuilt on the 3.4.6 en_gb skeleton (549 ids): 479 translations kept, 69 added (38 new upstream ids + 31 that were never translated), #31083 re-translated because upstream renamed 'Combined' to 'Combined Row'.
Upstream 3.4.4+ hard-requires two NEW art packs, resource.images.arctic.splash (>=1.0.6) and resource.images.arctic.weather (>=1.0.4), published in jurialmunkey's repo/zips datadir (not omega/zips): vendored verbatim (1.0.7 / 1.0.4) into addons/, added to build.json channels.optional and to the Arctic_Fuse_Skin.zip repack as 'add' (a repack only refreshes what the previous bundle carried), to the wizard's OPTIONAL_SKINS deps + SKIN_STACKS, and to refresh_vanilla_deps / adopt_deps / check_upstream so they track jurialmunkey like the other vanilla deps.
Upstream RENUMBERED the list viewtypes (506 List Basic -> 580, 507 -> 581, 508 List Expanded -> 582, 509 List Flixart -> 583, 549 -> 584; 506/509 now mean Row Flyer / Row Placard): the four skin.arctic.fuse.3-viewtypes.json seeds (config + af3-pov, af3-pov-tmdb, af3-gears-tmdb) were remapped, and the two pre-compiled script-skinviewtypes-includes.xml overrides were regenerated offline with script.skinvariables' own ViewTypes.make_xmltree against the 3.4.6 skinviewtypes.json (the generator reproduces the old committed file from the old inputs, so the output is what buildviews writes on a box). The af3-pov* script-skinvariables-generator-includes-.xml overrides are still compiled from the 3.3.0 templates (3.4.6 renamed the wall widget templates to standard/combined-row and consumes new *-standard-onunload includes); the wizard's post-install buildtemplate regenerates them on the box, but they should be re-captured from a live AF3 3.4.6 install. Skin settings dropped upstream: videoinfo.widgets.disabledirector/disablewriter/disablecreator (harmless in the seed).

3.2.18 - Re-base onto upstream 3.2.19. Upstream changed 44 files; only
1080i/Includes_Info.xml is one we overlay. 3-way merged.
The first attempt reported a conflict that was PHANTOM: our overlay copy was
CRLF while both upstream sides are LF, so the whole file looked rewritten.
Normalising all three sides first gave 0 conflicts and a real surface of 7
upstream lines and 5 of ours. The file is now written back as LF, matching
upstream, so this trap does not recur on the next re-base -- that is why this
commit shows the file as fully rewritten.
Kept: our KODIRDIL 18px gap so a long Hebrew plot never touches the ratings
row. Gained: upstream's new MyAnimeList rating block. Both verified present
in the merged file, which parses.

Hebrew skin overlay: Rubik/NotoSansHebrew fonts, gearsai subtitle OSD button (Custom_1147), Hebrew info labels.
